C-GITHUB-THEME.Name: GitHub theme family — GitHub and GitHub Dark editor themes
C-GITHUB-THEME.Summary: Add the GitHub theme family (github light + github-dark) built on GitHub Primer palette values, so writers who want the familiar clean GitHub reading look get it as a first-class system theme with a light/dark pair, matching the already GitHub-like C-39 table rendering.
C-GITHUB-THEME.ApprovalBasis: Owner instruction during the 2026-10-23 table-theming discussion: «кстати давай тему гитхаб сделаем, кому-то реально хочется чистого лаконичного» — make a GitHub theme for people who want the clean laconic look. Implementation is uncommitted until the owner reviews the result.

Goals.Goal: Ship github (Primer light: white ground #ffffff, ink #1F2328, blue accent #0969da, hairline #d1d9e0 borders, green primary buttons, h1/h2 bottom rules like a GitHub README) and github-dark (Primer dark default: #0d1117 ground, #f0f6fc ink, #4493f8 accent, #3d444d borders).

Full family registration: theme CSS + Prism companions, themeColor factories, themeMap, THEME_FAMILIES (17th family), railscasts dark classification, command palette entries, native View › Theme menu items, untranslated locale display names in all 10 locales.

Constraints.Constraint: Same variable set as paper.theme.css (theme-contrast variable-parity gate) and WCAG AA floors: editorColor/linkColor ≥ 4.5, blockquoteTextColor ≥ 3.0 on the editor background.
No changes to existing themes, the family model, Auto resolution, or table rendering; the family appends at the end of THEME_FAMILIES.
Nothing is committed or pushed until the owner reviews; release materials (What's New, README) are separate.

NonGoals.NonGoal: GitHub-flavored zebra/header painting for tables — that is the separate backlog feature «Table theming at system-theme level».
A GitHub export/print theme (academic/liber stay as they are).

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: theme-contrast gate passes for both new themes (variable parity + AA); theme-families, docs-macos family pins, tabs-appearance tile count, menu-consistency and command-registry tests all green after count updates (16→17 families, 32→34 members).
The Settings › Appearance grid shows the GitHub tile with real swatch colours; View › Theme lists GitHub and GitHub Dark; the command palette lists both.

AffectedAreas.Area: M-011 theme pipeline (assets/themes, themeColor.js, theme.js, themeFamilies.js, config.js classification); commands/index.js palette; src-tauri m009_menu.rs native menu; static/locales ×10; renderer theme/appearance/menu tests.
